messages:
alex_m: Heads-up — we're seeing cost drift on the spot-backed inference pool in us-west-2. p95 latency still OK, but interruption churn increased this week. Thinking about tightening surge controls and changing scale-out triggers. Anyone have quick ideas?
sara_ops: Can you paste the interruption rate and current hedging ratio?
alex_m: interruption ~6% day avg, spikes to 12% during maintenance windows. hedging ratio currently 20% reserved (warm), 80% spot.
jin_platform: 6% is getting risky for long-running chat sessions. Two quick levers: increase reserved to 30-40% for critical tiers, and add a scale-out cooldown that depends on recent interruption signal (longer cooldown when interruption >5%).
maria_s: Agree. Also consider a fast-fallback lane: if a spot host signals preempt within Xs, route to warm pool instead of retrying scale attempts. That avoids cascading scaleouts.
sara_ops: How does that interact with burst traffic? We don't want to overprovision reserved for rare spikes.
jin_platform: Use a token-bucket style surge gate. Keep burst allowance of N GPUMinutes that refills slowly. When burst tokens depleted, throttle new scale-outs to spot-only but with backoff.
alex_m: Can someone sketch the policy YAML for that surge gate?
maria_s: quick sketch:```yaml
policy: surge_gate
burst_capacity: 120m # gpu-minutes
refill_rate: 10m_per_minute
throttle_action: delay_scaleout_by_30s
fallback_on_preempt: route_to_warm
```
jin_platform: Nice. We should also make cooldown adaptive: base_cooldown = 60s, extra_cooldown = min(5m, interruption_pct*30s). So at 10% interruption extra ~5min cap.
sara_ops: What about cost target? CFO wants avg unit-cost <= $0.035/token for this fleet. If we raise reserved too much we'll blow it.
alex_m: OK tradeoff: set SLAs per customer tier. Gold/Enterprise => 40% reserved. Standard => dynamic reserved target that scales with observed preempt probability and latency SLO violations.
maria_s: Also add short-lived preemptible hedges: spin tiny reserve nodes in other AZs when cross-AZ network is healthy. Only route if latency delta < 20ms.
jin_platform: Good point — network constraints matter. We should add a probe check before failing over to cross-AZ reserved: ping latency + packet loss < thresholds. Keep that as a precondition in routing logic.
ops-bot: Autoscaler alert: preempt_rate_us-west-2 crossed 8% threshold at 2245006902.
deploy-bot: Canary policy deploy succeeded in us-west-2 with new surge_gate (canary id c-311).
sara_ops: After canary, monitor two metrics: scaleout_count_per_min and avg_failover_latency. If scaleout_count spikes, rollback.
alex_m: Also want to limit simultaneous scaleouts to avoid API pressure on cloud provider. Suggest cap concurrent scaleouts to 3 per fleet.
maria_s: Add jitter to scaleout start times when multiple triggers detected. That reduces API bursts.
jin_platform: For interruption handling inside runtime: persist short KV cache to allow resumed contexts on warm hosts and avoid full regen on fallback. Cuts cost of retries.
sara_ops: Action items: 1) jin to add adaptive cooldown logic + concurrent scaleout cap. 2) maria to implement surge_gate config and cross-AZ probe. 3) alex to roll revised hedging ratios for tiers. 4) ops to monitor cost per token and interruption metric.
alex_m: Thanks. I'll schedule a quick sync tom after we have telemetry from canary. :thumbsup:
